task_meta.title: Harden a CSV importer against bad rows

claim_text:
The importer now handles the format in `README.md`. Each bad row is skipped and reported with the line it starts on, everything else still imports, and nothing in the file's content can make it throw. All 24 tests pass (`dotnet run --project tests`).

**What was causing the failu
digest: Read 2 files (2 before its first edit), made 4 edits, ran tests 8 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
